content.title: Browse products, solutions, resources, and pricing
content.description: An anonymous visitor uses the global header, mega menus, and mobile navigation to discover product, solution, resource, and pricing pages, with menus opening by pointer or click, remaining keyboard-operable, collapsing into expandable mobile sections below the mobile breakpoint, and linking only to live public destinations that load successfully without long redirect chains.
content.summary: Use global navigation to reach public product, solution, resource, and pricing pages.
content.value: Supports the core discovery journey that routes visitors from the homepage to the right public information page.
criteria: The header exposes exactly five top-level menus: Products, Solutions, Why Twilio, Resources, and Pricing.
Each top-level menu opens a mega menu on hover or click and closes on outside click, Escape, and when another menu opens.

The Products menu exposes the documented sub-groups Twilio Platform, Conversations, Communications, Authentication, and Customer Data with representative destinations including Messaging, SMS, WhatsApp, Voice, Email, Verify, Lookup, Engage, and Audiences.

The Solutions menu exposes Use Cases, Teams, Industry, and Company Size with representative destinations including Verification and identity, Fraud prevention, Alerts and notifications, Appointment reminders, Mass texting, Marketing and promotions, Voice AI, IVR, Contact center, Financial services, Healthcare, Retail, Public sector, Education, Enterprise, and Startup.

The Why Twilio menu exposes Overview, Differentiators, and Company destinations including Why Twilio, Customer stories, One platform, Trust center, Enterprise scale, Global infrastructure, About us, Values, Diversity, Careers, Twilio.org, Investor relations, Press, and Events.

The Resources menu exposes Developers, Learn, and Support and services destinations including Documentation, Code Exchange, Developer Hub, Blog, Resource Center, Help Center, Partners, Support plans, and Status pages.

The Pricing menu exposes Overview, Conversations, Communications, Authentication, and Customer Data destinations including All pricing, Messaging pricing, SMS pricing, WhatsApp pricing, Voice pricing, Email API pricing, Video pricing, Flex pricing, Verify pricing, Lookup pricing, and CDP pricing.
Below the mobile breakpoint, navigation collapses to a toggle and all five menu groups remain reachable as expandable sections.
Every mega-menu link resolves to a live page returning HTTP 200 with no redirect chain longer than one hop.
